edits.to: seen from a comfortable distance, with the street clearly surrounding her

prompt.text: A 24-year-old adult Korean woman with her natural fair skin tone and round cheeks that dimple when she smiles, bright honey-orange brown hair in a layered Korean wolf cut. Curvy figure, 161 cm tall, bust 91 cm, waist 58 cm, hips 90 cm, F cup, full chest and slim waist. Light makeup with a glossy lip, her cheeks flushed pink from the cold. She wears a long deep-cranberry wool coat over an ivory ribbed knit mini dress, white knee-high boots and small pearl earrings. A quiet, environmental full-length portrait of a snowy hot-spring town street at blue hour, with snow falling softly. Low wooden inns with closed sliding doors line the street, and small warm paper lanterns glow along the eaves, receding into the distance. She stands in the middle of the street seen from a comfortable distance, with the street clearly surrounding her, in the soft glow of the lanterns, and tilts her face up to watch the falling snow with a small smile, not looking at the camera. Framing from top to bottom: a narrow band of rooftops and deep-blue sky, then the lantern-lit street with her whole figure, then open snowy road in front of her; both boots are fully in frame with snow below them. The warm lantern glow touches her face, her coat and the snow around her, and the rest of the scene stays cool blue. Vertical 3:4, eye level, natural perspective. A clean street with no shop signs, posters, wires, pipes or clutter. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading, finished like a page from a high-end photobook.

must.note: 後腳完整；前腳靴底剛好壓在照片區下緣（白邊），靴下沒有雪地。
天空只剩一條、沒有近景大燈籠，街道往中央深處退，人物在中間，比 R7 平衡；人物仍偏大（約照片區高度 77%），下方雪地不足。

must.k: 3. 沒有搶戲的大型物件、文字或雜物
must.note: 近景大燈籠消失；但左緣一盞燈籠有大字、右側有字的布招與招牌箱，天空有電線，右側有腳踏車與紅桶。比 R7 不搶戲，但仍可見。

must.k: 4. 讀得出抬頭看雪的瞬間
must.note: 沒有看鏡頭（有改善），但她轉頭看向畫面右側、一手在衣領旁，像走路時回眸的造型照，讀不出抬頭看雪。

must.k: 5. Somi 可辨識、成年；人景光色可信
must.note: 橘棕髮、圓臉、酒窩笑，可辨識且成年。臉部受光偏均勻柔和，周圍雪地看不出燈籠暖光圈，人物略亮於街景，但沒有明顯浮貼。

must.k: 6. 藍調時刻與酒紅／象牙白配色
must.note: 深藍天色、點亮的小燈籠、深蔓越莓紅大衣、象牙白針織與白靴，配色協調。

may_vary: 人物在中間（可容許）、大衣扣起下襬開（可容許）、臉的角度、雪量、燈籠數量都在可容許範圍，不列為失敗。
new_issue: 整張多了一圈白色相紙邊框，不是任何一項可容許變化；成品必須滿版，這張要裁切才可用，裁後約 286 ppi 且前腳仍貼邊。邊框很可能和收尾句「finished like a page from a high-end photobook」有關（推測，未驗證）；這句是 24 套共用收尾句，需要主管一併考量。

verdict.why: 第 2、6 項改善或通過；但第 1 項（前腳貼邊、靴下無雪）與第 4 項（讀不出抬頭看雪）不通過，第 3 項仍有文字與電線，另外出現白色相紙邊框。依 CAL_24，必要要求未全部達成。
verdict.not: 這是 Claude 自查，不是主管看圖覆核，也不是 Penny 接受。
